title: The faces in the first cup photograph.
deck: Look closely at the photograph that opens this museum.
body: A posed team photograph can make the distant past unexpectedly close. Albion’s 1888 players appear in striped shirts, with the formal posture and arrangements familiar from Victorian group portraits.

This surviving image is catalogued by Wikimedia Commons as the 1888 team. The photographer is unknown. Enlarge it and look at the individual faces, the clothing and the differences from a modern squad photograph. It is an archival photograph, rather than a modern reconstruction.
